rv.q: Jessie Buckley is hypnotised by Tim Crouch in remarkable play An Oak Tree … Buckley is the first star to take on a role sight unseen in a moving exploration of loss at London’s Young Vic … This extraordinary show is absolutely, extremely and very deliberately contrived: a slippery, shape-shifting duet that keeps changing the rules of engagement...
It's an extreme trust exercise and not everyone will reach the end unscathed.
